Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H4330)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 2721.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H4286)

subcommittees.name: Disability Assistance and Memorial Affairs Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans who served during WWII and subsequent eras prior to November 1990, their families, and the Department of Veterans Affairs.
dimensions.evidence: veterans who died on or before November 1, 1990

dimensions.assessment: Provides tangible memorial benefits to eligible families previously excluded due to date-of-death rules.
dimensions.evidence: furnish, pursuant to section 2306 of title 38... an appropriate headstone, burial marker, or medallion

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal costs for manufacturing and shipping headstones/markers during the pilot period and extends pension payment limits, though specific total dollar amounts are not stated.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall furnish... an appropriate headstone, burial marker, or medallion

dimensions.assessment: Creates a temporary pilot exception to existing burial benefit eligibility statutes and updates a pension deadline extension.
dimensions.evidence: establish and carry out a pilot program to furnish a headstone or burial marker

dimensions.assessment: The pilot authority lasts for seven years following enactment, and the pension extension runs through February 29, 2032.
dimensions.evidence: During the period of seven years following the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: The total number of eligible veterans who would claim the benefit and the aggregate financial cost are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a temporary two-year pilot program for the VA to furnish headstones or burial markers to certain veterans who died on or before November 1, 1990, and extends a pension payment limit.
